description: This file defines the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter class responsible for handling execution approval prompts, managing approval requests, user prompting, and decision handling within a macOS application using asynchronous streams and network communication.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing execution approval prompts, requests, and decisions within the app's security policy framework.

classes.name: GatewayApprovalRequest
classes.description: A Codable struct representing a request for execution approval, containing request metadata and timestamps.

classes.name: PresentationDecision
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the decision parameters for whether to prompt the user, presentation possibility, security settings, and allowlist entries.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the async task to listen for approval push events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing approval listening task.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronous loop that subscribes to approval streams and processes incoming pushes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an incoming push event related to execution approval requests, handling them based on policies and prompting the user if needed.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Determines if the approval request should be presented to the user based on current app state, session info, security policies, and recent activity.

methods.name: fallbackDecision
methods.description: Provides a default decision (allow or deny) based on fallback security policies and allowlist matching.

methods.name: fallbackResolution
methods.description: Resolves the executable path from the request for allowlist matching in fallback scenarios.

methods.name: firstToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token from a command string.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Static method to decide if a prompt should be shown based on connection mode, session info, last input activity, and threshold.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the number of seconds since the last user input activity.
